text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon sings right up through the
last song.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew. ☆ We did great! Everyone's
cleared out
already, huh?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Well, yes, but they all stayed until the
end! So if
you ask me—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I know! It was a resounding
success!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I stuffed my singing full of feelings... so I
just
know they resonated with someone.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, we're just getting started! ♪
choice_data_list: これからも頑張っていこう！

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hold on now, we haven't even said hello!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, Tachyon. And Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Hi, Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I bring good news—fantastic, even! You
see,
Suzuka here was so moved, she
wishes to
cooperate with your project!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, I...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Concerts hold the answer you seek.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, Suzuka has made up her mind!
She's ready
to work hard at her lessons,
starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, yesss! We're going to have
so much
fun, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: O-okay...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The concert really did bring more
people in...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it... captured hearts.
With the
power of song!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though everyone may have their own
reasons for
joining, our first concert did
succeed in
expanding the team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we keep holding these concerts, we
should
hopefully be able to draw more
and more
supporters yet!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Something's malfunctioning. I sense... an
error.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I feel... strange.
